model_name: Academic year category with new courses every year
category_structure: Trust > Board > School > Academic Year > Medium > Class/Std > Stream > Subject
student_move_method: Create next-year cohorts, add students to target cohort, cohort sync enrols them into next-year courses/groups.
when_to_use: Best for Indian schools needing annual records, board audits, gradebook history and clean year-wise course archives.
advantages: Clear year-wise archive; old results remain untouched; easy to hide old academic year category.
risks_or_notes: Creates more categories/courses; requires annual rollover process.

model_name: Existing categories with year in course/cohort codes
category_structure: Trust > Board > School > Medium > Class/Std > Stream > Subject Course named with year
student_move_method: Same as recommended model, but academic year is stored in course/cohort code and custom field rather than category.
when_to_use: Good when category tree must stay smaller but courses are still duplicated each academic year.
advantages: Less category depth; keeps historical courses.
risks_or_notes: Old and new year courses sit under same class category unless hidden/filtering is disciplined.

model_name: Reuse same courses and reset at year end
category_structure: Trust > Board > School > Medium > Class/Std > Stream > Subject
student_move_method: Remove old cohorts, add new cohorts, reset course user data/groups as needed.
when_to_use: Small schools without strict historical grade/report requirements.
risks_or_notes: Risk of losing convenient old course-level activity context; requires careful backup/export before reset.
